category_title: Students with blindness and autism exhibiting executive functioning deficits and low task independence
scenario_title: Independent Task Initiation and Executive Functioning
minimal_context: The student is expected to take out their materials and begin an independent classroom assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent study. Please get your materials out and start the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at the desk with a very slow tempo, not reaching for any materials or initiating the task.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you going to start working?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know how to begin.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to do it independently.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains completely still, showing no inner drive to take initiative or complete the task without someone pushing the start button.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for independent study. Please get your materials out and start the lesson.

STUDENT: (Sits at the desk with a very slow tempo, not reaching for any materials or initiating the task.)

TUTOR: Are you going to start working?

STUDENT: I don't know how to begin.

TUTOR: Just try to do it independently.

STUDENT: (Remains completely still, showing no inner drive to take initiative or complete the task without someone pushing the start button.)

task.content: Initiating and completing independent tasks during classroom lessons

context.materials: Materials to take out and put back or clean up

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When assigned unstructured tasks or when too much responsibility is left to the student
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Exhibits a slow tempo, does not know where to start, and neither begins nor completes a task independently
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Perceives the situation as difficult and stressful, lacks inner drive
related_quotes: The teacher needs to tell me exactly what to take out and what to do, otherwise I don’t know where to start
[S/he] has no inner drive. [S/he] neither knows how to begin, nor complete a task independently—you have to push the “start button” all the time

behavior_patterns.condition: When things are going too fast
